message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (June 18, 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  Roughly **23,000–25,000 soldiers** were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner in total:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allied (Bourbon & German) | 25,000–27,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | 22,000–24,000 |

These figures combine killed, wounded, missing, and captured.  The exact number varies slightly among sources, but most historians settle on the 23,000‑25,000 range for the combined total.
